data: nflverse depth charts + pbp 2015-2024, 32,038 analyzable player-weeks (top-3 slots, >=2 targets, exact next-week)
finding: PROMOTIONS DO NOT PREDICT GAINS: in every prior-production band the promoted player's next-week delta is slightly WORSE than non-moved players (regression to the mean + replacement dynamics — the promoted player fills a vacancy but the vacated targets do not transfer proportionally)
verdict: the naive depth-chart-bump template is falsified on 10 seasons; the honest primitive is 'promotion = replacement, expect mean reversion, not breakout'
doctrine: one primitive measured beats ten assumed — and a KILLED hypothesis is a success of the funnel
